name: offramp
description: Keeps new code in .NET Framework projects ready for .NET 8/10: flags APIs modern .NET lacks, and moves classes that need nothing from .NET Framework to a portable project.

enumDescriptions: On when the repository has an .offramp folder (a migration is under way), off otherwise.
On in this repository, with or without an .offramp folder.
offramp.enabled.markdownDescription: Whether Offramp checks new code. `auto` turns it on in repositories with an `.offramp` folder. Set it per user or per workspace.

offramp.projectMap.markdownDescription: Where a .NET Framework project's portable code lives, consulted before `projectMap` in `offramp.yml`. `from` and `to` are project names or repository-relative paths; `*` and `?` match in `from`, and `{name}` in `to` is the matched project's name.

from.description: The .NET Framework project (name or path; * and ? match).

to.description: The portable project its code can move to ({name} is the matched project's name).

offramp.newCode.base.markdownDescription: The git ref new code is compared with (its merge base with `HEAD`), for example `origin/main`. Unset: `ide.newCode.base` from `offramp.yml` (`auto`: `origin/HEAD`, else `HEAD`).

offramp.newCode.scope.markdownDescription: What counts as new: `lines` that changed, every line of a changed file (`files`), or `all` code. Unset: `ide.newCode.scope` from `offramp.yml` (`lines`).

offramp.implicitCounterparts.markdownDescription: Without a project map entry, suggest the portable projects a project already references. Unset: `ide.implicitCounterparts` from `offramp.yml` (`true`).

offramp.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show a **Move to …** lens on classes that can move to a portable project as they are.

offramp.server.path.markdownDescription: The `offramp` executable (or `offramp.dll`). Unset: the repository's local tool (`.config/dotnet-tools.json`), else `offramp` on `PATH`.

offramp.trace.server.description: Traces the messages between VS Code and the Offramp language server.

commands.title: Move file to a portable project
